what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Uzbekistan in all host countries combined: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 17404 asylum seekers from Uzbekistan.
The United States hosts the largest share, 84.1%, followed by South Korea, Canada and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Uzbekistan with the IMU in 1999 and 2000, and with JIG in 2004.
The fact pack records no armed conflict in Uzbekistan in recent years, so it does not say why the number of asylum seekers grew.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 372 asylum seekers.
The figure reached its highest point, 22765, at the end of 2024, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals of asylum seekers summed over every host country; refugees from Uzbekistan are counted separately.
